messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired — INCIDENT 5078 for inference-api-eu. Severity: P0. Symptoms: sudden 5xx spike (~1200/min at peak), p99 latency up to ~1.8s. Start: ~10:24 UTC. Links: PD https://pagerduty.com/incidents/5078 · Grafana https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/inf-eu · runbook: https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks#kv-cache-eviction

maria: taking this — maria (oncall). I'll ack in PD and start triage. @sam @lee please standby.

sam: on it. checking pod restarts, autoscaler events, and recent deploys. running `kubectl get pods -n inference-eu --sort-by=.status.startTime` now.

lee: quick grep of logs shows repeated `rpc: context deadline exceeded` and `kv cache allocation failed` across several replicas. could be cache pressure + slow disk.

maria: customer impact estimate: approx 3.2% of EU requests getting 5xx during the spike window. Top affected orgs: acme-corp, solstice-analytics. CS pinged? @ana

ana: (ana) notifying CS now, creating short customer PSAs for top customers. Will escalate to support queue and post status.

sam: initiating scale: increasing dedicated-inference-pool eu-2 by +2 GPUs (reserve). Also pausing non-critical batch jobs on eu-region to free memory.

lee: observed error sample: `2026-03-17T10:24:41Z inference-server[pid=2431]: failed to allocate kv cache segment: out of memory` — looks like unbounded KV growth while handling some malformed streaming clients.

maria: mitigation plan (short): 1) scale pool +2 GPUs (sam) 2) roll routing fallback to stable model-variant v1 (rollback quantized v2 experiment) 3) pause batch workloads 4) notify CS. Executing now.

sam: scale applied — +2 GPUs requested, nodes provisioning. Triggered warmup for model v1 on 2 replicas. Commands used: ```./infra scale --pool eu-2 --add-gpus 2```

sam: autoscale finished — new GPUs online. Warmup succeeded for v1 replicas. Observed p95 latency drop to ~450ms, 5xx rate down to ~40/min (from ~1200/min).

maria: good progress. I'll keep monitoring for 15 minutes. If metrics hold at T+20m we'll move to resolved -> postmortem. Leaving PD note: mitigations applied, monitoring.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: Incident 5078 acknowledged by maria. Status changed: acknowledged -> monitoring. Escalation paused.

maria: handing ownership to eng-oncall lee for RCA and follow-up. Summary note: suspected KV cache growth triggered by malformed streaming requests, exacerbated by a quantized model variant memory regression. Need deeper heap traces and request patterns.

lee: taking ownership for RCA and postmortem. I'll gather heap dumps, KV usage histograms, and correlate with client request ids. Creating JIRA INF-2134 for follow-up and remediation tasks (limits, circuit breakers, improved telemetry).

sam: adding a short hotfix candidate: enforce max-kv-segments=1024 and add defensive checks in model loader — will propose via PR after RCA triage.

maria: thanks all. CS notified, customer-facing note posted. Monitoring nominal for +12m. If nothing regresses I'll resolve PD.

incident-bot: Incident 5078 resolved (mitigated -> resolved) at 10:49 UTC. Duration: ~25m. Final note: scale + rollback applied; eng-oncall owning RCA (lee).

sam: :thumbsup:

lee: will schedule postmortem and invite infra/model teams.
